response.sql: WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(CAST(points AS FLOAT)) as total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND laps != '' THEN CAST(laps AS FLOAT) END) as avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_points_total, AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps FROM driver_stats;

assumptions.assumption: Empty strings in the laps column should be treated as missing values and excluded from the laps average
